channel.title: TMPlayer releases
channel.description: What changed in every TMPlayer release, newest first: Android TV, phones, Windows and Linux, all from one release.

item.title: TMPlayer 1.22.1
item.description: Videos play on Android TV again. In 1.22.0 the player closed itself a few seconds into every video on a television; phones and computers were not affected.

item.title: TMPlayer 1.22.0
item.description: Smaller downloads. The Android APK is about half its old size, and the Windows and Linux packages are a third to almost two thirds smaller. The Linux tarball is now a .tar.xz.

item.title: TMPlayer 1.21.0
item.description: Finished episodes now get a tick, and any video can be marked as watched or unwatched by hand. A new Watched tab lists what you have finished. Searching a chat now finds videos outside the size limits, and the grid says how many videos the limits are hiding. On a TV, the release page opens as a QR code. On Windows, the media keys and the media flyout control the player.

item.title: TMPlayer 1.20.0
item.description: The first release with a desktop app for Windows and Linux. It signs in with the same Telegram account and plays the same chats, with the keyboard, the mouse and your media keys.

item.title: TMPlayer 1.16.0
item.description: No notes were written for this release.
